stemMd: If the sensor fails, a red light appears. A red light appears. Which additional premise would make sensor failure logically certain?

options.label: A
options.textMd: A red light appears only if the sensor fails.

options.label: C
options.textMd: A working sensor can also produce a red light.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The light is easy to see.

options.label: E
options.textMd: The sensor is near the door.

explanationMd: The original implication alone cannot be reversed. The added only-if statement supplies red light implies failure. Together with the observed red light, that implication entails sensor failure.

distractorRationale.b: This does not rule out other causes of red light.
distractorRationale.d: Visibility does not establish its sole cause.
distractorRationale.e: Location is irrelevant to the implication.
distractorRationale.c: This permits the alternative the inference must exclude.
